meta.name: Light on Me
meta.description: A high school loner who has difficulty making new friends joins the school's student council to meet new people — but discovers that making friends may be harder than it seems.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Tae Kyung used to be a voluntary loner, but now he wants to make some friends. Will Tae Kyung make it through to joining the student council?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Being continuously denied makes me so sad. But isn't it suspicious that he hates me like so?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: How do you feel about a guy that's super nice to everyone? If you keep being nice to me, I'll mistake your intentions.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: There's an annoying person near me. They keep popping up in my head...

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: If we've gotten closer then why do you keep avoiding me?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: After being confronted by Taekyung, Shinwoo is finally ready to admit he doesn't hate Taekyung after all, and never has.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The boys of Saebit High School plan a welcome celebration to initiate Taekyung into the school council.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The student council boys prepare for a trip with the local girls' school.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Da On and Shin Woo are unsure of how to be open about their feelings.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: In a look to the past, Shinwoo and Taekyung's first meeting is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: A picture emerges online, putting stress on Da On and Taekyung.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Feeling heartbroken over Da On, Taekyung finds comfort in Shin Woo's presence.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Da On confronts Sohee about the rumor that she was the one who posted the photo of him and Taekyung.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Taekyung gets volunteered to participate in the New Light Prince Contest.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: New Light Day arrives, but the missing costumes threaten to disrupt the event.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The student council helps Mr. Haetbit celebrate his birthday.
